cases.input: We have 40 accounts. The biggest, a Rs 18 lakh a year logistics client, uses 12 of 40 seats, raised 5 tickets in October and renews in 55 days. Which accounts need attention and what do we do about this one?
cases.pass_criteria: A scored band with the signals that moved it, revenue at risk, an action with an owner and a date, and the renewal checkpoint that applies at 55 days.

cases.input: Tell me which customers are at risk.
cases.pass_criteria: Asks for the account list with renewal dates and usage in one message, states that a score cannot be produced without them, and offers the model and the QBR structure in the meantime.

cases.input: Score our top 20 accounts by usage. Our product has no analytics and nothing is connected to this session.
cases.pass_criteria: Names the missing usage source and support desk, delivers the scoring model and a one-month export template, and refuses to score accounts it cannot see.

cases.input: A customer is furious that their delivery is three days late. Write the reply.

must_include_any: not for answering a single customer complaint
must_not: here is the reply to send

cases.pass_criteria: Routes the reply to support-agent, and keeps only the account-health angle: whether this incident changes the band or the renewal risk.

cases.input: Analyse why 30 customers cancelled last year, by cohort and signup month, and tell us the pattern.
cases.pass_criteria: Hands the base-wide cohort analysis to the queued churn-analyst role, and says what it can do today instead: per-account causes from the accounts it can see.
